notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey there !

Today I rolled out a new Chromatic update after all this time.
It's mostly constituted of balance changes to make make the game more even for the player and to address some problems.

[h1] Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Buffed Healer HP by 10%
   [*] Buffed Healer recover by 10%
   [*] Buffed enemy's regular plasma projectile damage by 16%
   [*] Tweaked final boss Offensive phase to make it more fair
   [*] Increased signficantly points for destroying final boss crystals (offensive and defensive)
   [*] Nerfed final boss HP by 16%
   [*] Buffed player laser dps from 465 to 480
   [*] Slightly more Health packs will appear
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Splash screen overhaul !
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Fixed and optimized comet VFX (less lag)
   [*] Fixed a bug where all Security devices (laser) would go off-screen (oops !)
[/list]

notes.title: Chromatic is turning free soon !
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29596254/3156b67d490c59a2b414e6aabd27c9173a69fa43.png[/img]
Yes, you read it right ! 

First of all, I want to thank every player who purchased the game to support me. I really appreciate it.

However, as you might know, I developed this game to gather personal experience and notoriety rather than to gain money and I planned since the beginning to switch to this model in 2018. 

I gave away the game at multiple occasions to make the payout barrier non existing, even if I'm asking a very low price for Chromatic, as many people told me.

Now, in order to make things clear, this price change will be effective on [b]January 23rd[/b] with according Valve authorization.

What if you bought the game ? Well, I cannot refund personally every single purchaser as I cannot differentiate the ones that actually paid from the one that got it free, but I have something special for you next up, in the [b]new game[/b] I'm currently developing (I can't say more, but it will be free). I appreciate your involvement and I consider everything I got as a donation and an encouragement for me to continue <3

If you want more details over the dev process of Chromatic, look my [url=http://majstudio.cf]brand new website[/url] !

Thanks again for your support and understanding and see you soon !

Marc Jacob

notes.title: Patch 1.01 live !
notes.notes:
A very small patch fixing some little bugs.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Fixed various UI bugs related to Co-op mode with 2 controllers.
   [*] Fixed a bug where 2nd player's controller buttons were incorrectly binded.
[/list]

Thats all for now !
